iut_type: BLE product using Fanstel module (Nordic-based, integrated antenna)
customer_question: What is the rough cost and timeline for Bluetooth SIG certification when using an integrated-antenna, pre-certified BLE module (Fanstel BM805 or BM832, Nordic-based)?
question_variants: Certified BLE module with integrated antenna: what tests are required and what is the cost?
If the module already has a QDID, what certification steps remain for the end product?
Pre-certified module, no SIG profiles — what is the minimum registration cost?
actual_issue: Pyke Crystal is evaluating Bluetooth SIG certification for their first Bluetooth product. They plan to use a Fanstel module (Nordic-based, integrated antenna) and are not sure what tests and costs are required given the module is already SIG-certified.
plain_english_explanation: When using a pre-certified BLE module that has an integrated antenna, both RF PHY testing and all core layer testing (LL, L2CAP, GAP, GATT, ATT, SM) are exempt — the module's QDID already covers all of these. If the product implements no SIG-standardized profiles (only custom/proprietary GATT services), no profile testing is required either. The only remaining costs are the registration service fee and the SIG Qualification Fee. If SIG-standardized profiles are added, each profile costs approximately ¥100,000 for PTS testing.
consultant_answer: Both Fanstel BM805 and BM832 modules are certified with integrated antennas. Therefore: (1) RF PHY testing is exempt; (2) Core layer testing is exempt. If the product implements no SIG-standardized profiles (or only proprietary GATT), no profile test is required. Pricing without profile testing: Single Design registration ¥150,000 + Compliance Folder ¥150,000 + SIG Qualification Fee $11,040. Registration takes 3 business days (after SIG fee receipt). If SIG profiles are added later, each profile test costs approximately ¥100,000.
decision_logic: Integrated-antenna certified module → RF PHY exempt + core layers exempt. No SIG profiles → no profile test. Single-Design reference (one QDID) → ¥150,000 registration. Timeline: 3 business days from SIG fee receipt (not from order), with ~3 weeks for SIG wire transfer.
final_recommendation: Use the certified Fanstel module with integrated antenna to minimize testing requirements. Choose between Single Design (one QDID) at ¥150,000 or Multi-Design (multiple QDIDs) at ¥250,000 depending on whether the Host and Controller are registered separately. If no SIG profiles are implemented, no profile testing is needed.
risk_if_done_wrong: Using an external antenna or modifying the antenna configuration would invalidate the integrated-antenna exemption and require RF PHY testing.
